title: United in Diversity? Contextual Biases in LLM-Based Predictions of the 2024 European Parliament Elections

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the accuracy of LLM predictions for individual voting behavior (turnout and party vote shares) against actual aggregate 2024 European Parliament election results across 27 EU member states, focusing on performance discrepancies between Western and Eastern/Southern European countries.

Evaluating the predictive performance of LLMs across different native language families (e.g., Slavic, Baltic, Romance, Germanic) and measuring the difference in predictive accuracy when models are prompted in English versus the respective country's native language.
